note: Widal test is the correct confirmatory test for typhoid. Biopsy and PCR are throwaway distractors; ELISA is the only plausible one. Clean direct recall.
Clean pair item: IgE and mast cells are correct, and the IgA and macrophage options are the common student errors. Explanation facts check out.
Key D verified: entry into macrophage, reverse transcription, integration, then progeny attack T cells. Choice between B and D rests on the integration step; explanation accurate.
Heroin, Papaver somniferum and depressant effect are all correct. Each distractor fails on a different fact (cocaine on drug and plant, cannabis on plant, D on effect).
Key A correct. The passage restates the behaviour, so the stem is over-signposted; C (neoplastic transformation) names a process, not a property one loses. Score down one point.
Key C correct. Options B and D are weak reasons and A is only a partial trap; the passage gives the lymph-node cue directly, so the item is easy to reason out.
Proto-oncogene to oncogene and tobacco as a chemical carcinogen are both correct. Viral and physical options are clean distractors; the two-part answer is well paired.
Key D correct and explanation accurate. A, B and C are plainly wrong and the passage signposts spread to a lymph node, so the item is answered by elimination.
Key C is the only option set consistent with A and D true, but (B) rests on radiotherapy sparing neighbours, which is only approximately true. A sceptic can dispute it.
Starter, multiplication, lactic acid, then coagulation is correct. A and D are plausible order errors; C starts with multiplication before the starter is added, a weak one.
Key A checked against aeration, floc growth with falling BOD, settling into activated sludge, then anaerobic digestion. Distractors fail on floc-before-aeration and digestion-first errors.
All four pairings correct: citric acid, acetic acid, ethanol, streptokinase. Each distractor is a plausible microbe-product swap, so this is a well-built match list.
Key B verified: wine and beer are undistilled, whisky, brandy and rum are distilled, lipases are not clot busters, penicillin is named after P. notatum. Each wrong option carries one false statement.
Key C correct: statins competitively inhibit cholesterol synthesis. The other three options give the roles of other microbial products, which are decent distractors.
Trichoderma is the only antifungal biocontrol here. The three distractors are insect biocontrols, a clean trap for students who think biocontrol means insects.
Key D correct. The word photosynthetic alone leaves only Anabaena, so the stem over-signposts; Rhizobium and Glomus are fair distractors.
Mix, denature, anneal, extend is correct and explained. Each distractor swaps one standard pair of steps, a plausible student error; well-built sequence item.
Origin of replication controls copy number. Marker, recognition site and promoter are the standard distractors; direct recall with an accurate explanation.
Stirrer mixes contents and keeps oxygen available. A and D are downstream steps and C a pre-inoculation step; plausible distractors for a student who knows the bioreactor.
